# The Interfold

> The Interfold is an open-source protocol that coordinates Encrypted Execution
> Environments (E3s) across a distributed network of ciphernodes, so independent
> parties can produce shared, verifiable outcomes from private inputs -- without
> custody, exposure, or trusted hardware.

The Interfold was previously named **Enclave**. Material published before the
rename -- including the enclave.gg domain, which now redirects here -- refers to
the same protocol.

## What it does

Multiple parties submit encrypted inputs. A program computes over them without
decrypting them. A ciphernode committee holds the decryption key in shares under
distributed threshold cryptography, so no single operator can decrypt anything
alone, and the result is publicly verifiable without revealing the inputs behind
it. The project calls this **confidential coordination**.

The cryptographic stack combines Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE),
Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs), and Distributed Threshold Cryptography (DTC) --
threshold BFV and PV-TBFV, with circuits written in Noir.

## What it is used for

- **Sealed-bid and batch auctions** -- bids stay private, the clearing outcome stays verifiable.
- **Private voting and governance** -- confidential ballots, verifiable tallying, receipt-free voting, no trusted ballot operator.
- **Processing sensitive data** -- personal, financial, or regulated data handled without custody of plaintext.
- **Multiparty computation workflows** -- independent parties compute together without pooling their data.
- **Collaborative data analysis** -- organisations jointly compute over sensitive datasets without exposing records.

## Three ways to participate

- **Run a ciphernode** -- operate infrastructure for confidential coordination: https://dashboard.theinterfold.com/#operator
- **Build and integrate** -- build applications on private inputs and verifiable outcomes: https://docs.theinterfold.com/getting-started
- **Partner on a pilot** -- bring a live use case and deploy it: mailto:comms@gnosisguild.org

## Pages on this site

- [Home](https://www.theinterfold.com/): the execution model, what becomes possible, and routes into the network.
- [Participate](https://www.theinterfold.com/participate): the three roles -- requestors, ciphernode operators, and builders -- and how they fit together.
- [FOLD auction](https://www.theinterfold.com/fold-auction): the FOLD token auctions, now closed, and the claim route.
- [Auction terms](https://www.theinterfold.com/auction/legal): legal terms for the FOLD auction.

## Elsewhere

- [Documentation](https://docs.theinterfold.com/): architecture, E3 computation flow, cryptography, SDK, tutorials, ciphernode operation.
- [Blog](https://blog.theinterfold.com/): writing on confidential coordination and the architecture behind the network.
- [Node dashboard](https://dashboard.theinterfold.com/): register, bond, and operate a ciphernode.
- [Source code](https://github.com/theinterfold/interfold): the protocol, contracts, and audits.
- [X](https://x.com/theinterfold) and [Telegram](https://t.me/enclave_e3): announcements and community.
